description: Use when someone lists the analyzers in their lab or clinic and wants a plan for getting all their results into their EHR, LIS or practice system (e.g. 'we have a Sysmex XP-300, an i-STAT and an Afinion 2, how do we connect them to athenahealth?', 'plan the interfaces for our new urgent care lab', 'what do I need on site to connect these analyzers?'). Returns one plan: per analyzer the connection status (Driver built, Connection guide, or Catenix builds the driver, usually within a couple of days), the physical link (serial, network, USB or vendor software), protocol and what is needed on site; the on-site gateway and record-system route; patient matching; and a step-by-step go-live checklist. Renders an interactive Lab Map in ChatGPT and Claude. Does not interpret results.

analyzers.description: Analyzer makes and models as the user wrote them.

ehr.description: EHR, LIS or practice system, if known.

setting.description: Type of service, e.g. 'urgent care', 'private lab', 'GP practice'.
